job_description_text:
Data Platform Engineer

Senior Full-time Remote US. What you will bring:
1. Strong experience with Python for data pipelines
2. Hands-on Spark and Airflow in production
3. Comfortable with AWS (S3, EMR, IAM)
4. Familiarity with dbt is a plus
5. Snowflake experience is nice to have

You will help scale our analytics warehouse and keep batch jobs reliable.
